uncertain_notes: TableSeaPortBuildingLev/other_bundle_rows (tabledata_v1.ab): all 25 rows contain the identical generic placeholder text '建筑是一个需要建造的建筑' (literally 'the building is a building that needs to be built'), which looks like unfinished/dev placeholder text rather than real content. Translated literally and consistently as 'A building that needs to be constructed.' rather than inventing real descriptions.

TableShipGroupTask/other_bundle_rows ids 8-10 taskDesc: source says '无限制赛达到X分' (tabledata_v1.ab) vs '巅峰赛达到X分' (tabledata.ab) for the same taskTitle '天梯积分'. Translated 无限制赛 literally as 'Unrestricted Match' (as distinct from '巅峰赛'/'Peak Arena') since it's not in the established glossary; could also be a build-revision renaming of the same ranked mode.
TableShipGroupTaskGroup groupTitle '期间任务': translated as 'Event Missions' (limited-time/seasonal mission group); 'Period Missions' or 'Limited-Time Missions' are plausible alternates.
TableShipGroupTrialProp id 2 '魂玉': translated as 'Soul Orb' (distinct from 宝石/'Gem' and from 附魂/'Soul-Enchant' in the established glossary) since it doesn't appear in prior glossary entries.
TableShipGroupTrialProp id 12 '霸气' translated as 'Haki', the established official One Piece localization term for this power, not a generic 'Domineering/Dominance'.

TableShipGroupTrialBoss bossName '大熊' translated as 'Kuma' (Bartholomew Kuma), matching common One Piece localization naming style used for the other bosses (Ace, Garp, Enel, etc. rather than full titles).
TableGvoShip shipId 130013 '风·格拉玛号': no confirmed canonical One Piece ship by this name found; transliterated/translated literally as 'Wind Grama'.
TableGvoShip shipId 130016 '极地潜水号': translated literally as 'Polar Diver'; not the same as Law's canonical submarine 'Polar Tang', which uses different characters.
TableGvoShip shipId 130017 '幽灵船': translated literally as 'Ghost Ship'; no specific canonical named vessel identified.

TableGvoShip shipId 130022 '珠宝玛格丽塔号': translated literally as 'Jewelry Margarita'; likely intended as Jewelry Bonney's ship ('珠宝' matches her epithet 'Jewelry'), but the exact canonical/official ship name for Bonney was not confirmed.
TableGvoShip shipId 130024 '维多利亚朋克号': transliterated as 'Victoria Punk'; no confirmed canonical source identified.
TableGvoShip shipId 130025 'Stay Tune号': kept as-is ('Stay Tune'), already in Latin script in the source.
TableGvoShip shipId 130026 '般城丸号': transliterated as 'Hanjo Maru' (a Japanese-style ship name); not a widely confirmed canonical reference.
TableGvoShip shipId 130032 '白星': translated literally as 'White Star'; no confirmed canonical One Piece ship/character reference identified for this name.

TableSeaAreaShipSkill: ids 1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 12, 15 use skillName '测试技能名字' ('Test Skill Name') and skillDesc '这是一个技能' ('This is a skill') -- clearly unfinished dev placeholder rows, not real content. Translated literally rather than inventing real skill text.
TableUnionTradeShipReward id 3 '油菜花贸易' ('Canola Blossom Trade'): no confirmed canonical One Piece location by this name was identified; translated literally.
TableUnionTradeShipReward quality field ('E级'/'D级'/etc.) rendered as 'E-Rank'/'D-Rank'/etc.
